text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's the final showdown with Dober of the 
Mejiro family! The pedigree she was born 
with, the unbridgeable gap in our 
circumstances— God might accept all that, 
but I sure as hell won't!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll win this race and prove it! That a 
bond with a complete stranger can be 
stronger than family!
